question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: **CLOUT**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Power**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Clout"** means influence or power, especially in a political or social context. (प्रभाव, शक्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** His political clout helped him secure the funding for the project.
 
 
 
• **"Power"** refers to the ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way, or the ability to control or influence others. (शक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** The CEO has significant power to make decisions that impact the company.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Clout'** is **'Power'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Power**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Weakness** (कमज़ोरी): Lack of strength or influence.

 
 
• **Example:** His weakness in math made it difficult for him to pass the exam.
 
 
 
• **Unimportance** (महत्त्वहीनता): Lack of significance or value.
 
 
• **Example:** The unimportance of the issue was evident in the lack of discussion about it.
 
 
 
• **Failure** (असफलता): Lack of success in achieving a goal.
 
 
• **Example:** The failure of the project resulted in financial losses for the company.
 
 

38:T60e,

The correct answer is **option 2 i.e. Unanimous.**
